name: hcportal_deleteNewsflash
description: Soft-deletes a portal newsflash by setting IsDeleted=1 and UpdatedAt=GETUTCDATE(). The newsflash immediately stops being returned by hcportal_getPendingNewsflashes. Associated HC.PortalNewsflashRead records are retained for audit; hcportal_getNewsflashReaders continues to work on soft-deleted newsflashes. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with a NULL callerParamString; any authenticated portal user may call it — there is no permission gate in the SP (the portal restricts the screen). HC.PortalNewsflash has no file in db/schema/tables; its definition is in db/hc6/portal/archive/create_portal_newsflash_tables.sql.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with NULL callerParamString.

parameters.name: newsflashId
parameters.description: Required: the newsflash to soft-delete. Validated for NULL BEFORE auth. Must exist and not already be soft-deleted ('Newsflash not found').

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on any outcome — success, validation failure, auth failure, or runtime error.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: NULL on success, error message on failure

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.PortalNewsflash SET IsDeleted=1, UpdatedAt=GETUTCDATE() WHERE NewsflashId=@newsflashId

codeSmells.issue: CATCH does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 70-73: the CATCH rolls back and returns ERROR_MESSAGE() but writes no HC.ErrorLog row, so a runtime failure leaves no server record.
After ValidatePortalAuth (line 40) any authenticated portal user can delete any newsflash; the check that the caller is a platform admin lives only in the client.

codeSmells.issue: Raw database error returned to the user
codeSmells.detail: Line 72 returns ERROR_MESSAGE() as the user-facing ErrorMessage.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change soft-delete to hard-delete — PortalNewsflashRead rows depend on the parent row existing
